title: Resolve remaining Expo toolchain dependency advisories with consumer compatibility evidence

detail: The separate SEC003Vite repair does not resolve mobile dependency alerts. Direct Zod4.6.7is outside the reported<4.6.6range, while Expo CLI also locks Zod3.25.76; assess affected collection-validation behavior and consumer support before forcing major3to4 or claiming a false positive. Expo CLI/code-signing dependencies lock node-forge1.4.0; current authoritative advisory reports<=1.4.0with no patched release. Map the actual signing/verification exposure and test an upstream-supported mitigation rather than dismissing toolchain findings. The xcode dependency locks uuid7.0.3; fixed11.1.1is a major update and requires consumer/API/round-trip project compatibility proof. These are package/version and source-path observations, not demonstrated production exploitability or native-device behavior. Do not blanket-dismiss alerts or override incompatible APIs to make scanners green. Resolve compatible updates in task-owned dependency environments, preserve pinned lockfiles, exercise actual consumers and native lint/typing/pure tests, and record any genuinely unpatchable upstream limitation separately from completed repairs. No provider/production mutation is authorized. On 2026-10-25 the integrated audit candidate includes SEC-005, the scoped xcode UUID11.1.1 repair published separately as draft3905. Its frozen mobile install, typing, lint and pure/toolchain tests pass both against current main and alongside the Frequency token repairs. The actual Expo consumer generates1000IDs and round-trips a synthetic PBX group/file. This supersedes the earlier UUID7 lock observation only in this integrated candidate; default-branch release and native acceptance are not inferred. Zod3 and node-forge remain open. Later 2026-10-25 actual installed Expo consumer tracing confirms remaining exposure boundaries: CLI declares Zod^3.25.76; DevToolsPlugin.schema contains unbounded command, parameter and output arrays and MCP schema generation consumes those definitions. A forced Zod4 override lacks declared consumer support and full parser/transport compatibility proof. @expo/code-signing-certificates calls certificate.verify and publicKey.verify; iOS Security.js parses OS-provided certificate PEM. The current node-forge advisory still lists no patched release. Source reachability is not a demonstrated app exploit, but developer-tool classification alone is not a mitigation. No local cryptographic replacement or incompatible major override was made. UUID draft3905 exacthead48ed2bb76 now has green rootCI24082pass/2skip1992files plus mobiletyping/lint/8pure+2toolchain tests; combined audit proof remains separate.
